items.title: Evergy's Q2 Earnings Beat Estimates, Revenues Increase Y/Y
items.summary: EVRG beats Q2 earnings and revenue estimates as Kansas Central and Metro post gains while reaffirming its 2026 adjusted EPS guidance.

items.title: Utilities threaten action if lawmakers fail to cut their wildfire liability risk
items.summary: Top executives of California's two biggest utilities warned they would take action to protect their shareholders if Sacramento lawmakers fail to pass legislation limiting their companies' liabilities for wildfires sparked by their equipment

items.title: PEG Q2 Earnings Outpace Expectations, Revenues Decrease Y/Y
items.summary: PSEG beats Q2 earnings estimates as utility investments, higher realized prices and nuclear generation support results despite lower revenues.

items.title: NRG Energy Q2 Earnings Lag Estimates, Revenues Increase Y/Y
items.summary: NRG's Q2 earnings miss estimates, but revenues climb 11% as lower operating costs and shareholder returns support performance.

items.title: Edison International Q2 Earnings Surpass Estimates, Revenues Miss
items.summary: EIX Q2 earnings surge 58.8% and beat estimates by 51%, while revenues decline and miss expectations.

items.title: IDACORP Q2 Earnings Outpace Estimates, Revenues Increase Y/Y
items.summary: IDA surpasses Q2 earnings estimates as customer growth, rate changes and large contracts lift results, while revenues rise and guidance improves.

items.title: American Electric's Q2 Earnings Lag Estimates, Revenues Increase Y/Y
items.summary: AEP's Q2 earnings miss estimates as tax timing and a prior transaction weighed despite 7% revenue growth and raised 2026 guidance.

items.title: Is Wall Street Bullish or Bearish on PG&E Corporation Stock?
items.summary: As PG&E Corporation has outperformed relative to the broader market over the past year, Wall Street analysts maintain a bullish outlook about the stock’s prospects.
